description: Seismic Portal is a dataset listed in Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality open data portal, a city open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by Department of Information Technologies. Through the Seismic Portal, it is possible to access the information of earthquakes occurring in selected areas. Coverage: Department of Information Technologies. The publisher named on the listing is Department of Information Technologies. Its keywords include deprem, deprem şiddeti, portal, sismik, şiddet. The listing shows 1 download or service links in HTML. The listing shows 2022-04-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality Open Data License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-ibb-gov-tr.
